plugins.name: Audio player
plugins.description: Plays music from a folder on your machine, with a transport in the chat window. Reads ID3 and Vorbis tags out of MP3, FLAC, Ogg and Opus, so it knows who performed a track even when the file name does not say. The model can start a song, build a playlist, skip and pause — and offers a list to click when several files could be what you meant. A playlist gathered from more than one album is shuffled, so a band comes out in a different order every time; an album keeps the order it was sequenced in.
plugins.author: alexbeatnik
